analysis:
The 175 GW target (100 GW solar, 60 GW wind, 10 GW biomass, 5 GW small hydro) was clarified by MNRE in October 2019 as due by 31 December 2022. It excludes large hydro.

On 31 December 2022, solar was 63.30 GW, wind 41.93 GW, biomass 10.73 GW and small hydro 4.94 GW, a total of 120.90 GW or about 69% of the target. Biomass exceeded its sub-target; solar, wind and especially rooftop solar fell short. The Standing Committee on Energy attributed the gap to low rooftop solar and wind installations.

Capacity grew from 35.85 GW (March 2014) to 109.89 GW (March 2022) on MNRE figures, roughly tripling, and annual additions reached 14-15 GW in 2021-22 and 2022-23. The 175 GW level was crossed only after 2024-25 on the derived series.
